candidate_pool: original FP32 sigmoid, each of whole/TL/TR/BL/BR top600; Q300x10
score_precision: input FP32; iterative multiplication and exp FP64
IoU: continuous original-image xyxy FP64; no +1, clip, coordinate fusion or hard threshold
selection: per class current score maximum after every decay; ties view/query/category ascending
zeros: retain original zeros, subnormals and finite underflow-to-zero; count each; no cutoff
nonfinite: STOP; no nan_to_num or score repair
output: global descending decayed score, view/query/category; top300 same prefix of top600
ignore: original raw-ignore after budget truncation; no refill; GT never enters postprocess
cross_seed: all 14 gates pass separately in each of all three seeds; paired mean/sample SD/min reported
original_results: reuse A/B/C points without rescoring; original decisions unchanged
cache_admission: all seeds and all raw-views SHA/identity/geometry verified; exact A/B/C rebuild before any new scoring
wait: server-only independent CPU continuation waits for original chain completion and slim export; no local polling
return_policy: explicit small whitelist only; raw caches/predictions/logs remain server-side
